known_pitfall_claim: For arbitrary enumerations of J and K, the two series beginning at n=1 converge absolutely to r equivalently.
pitfall_counterexample: Take I=J=K=ℕ, values in ℝ, r=0, and v(i)=1 if i=0, otherwise 0. Let j(n)=n. Let k swap 0 and 1: k(0)=1, k(1)=0, and k(n)=n for n≥2. Both j and k are bijective enumerations.
